note: Display-only rasters. Never numerical terrain; never mission-time illumination. Generated by tools/sources/build_visual_layers.py.

layers.title: Controlled 1 m/pixel South Pole Average Mosaic (window)
layers.label: LROC NAC AVG · VISUAL
layers.cite: Archinal et al. (2023), Controlled High-Resolution LROC NAC Polar Mosaics, LPSC 54, abstract 2333

sourceHash.note: hash of the little-endian float32 window bytes; the 8.28 GB tile was not downloaded in full

projection.axes: +x toward 90 E, +y toward 0 E (same as PGDA 78/90)

layers.frame: controlled to LOLA track data (ISIS jigsaw); planetocentric, east-positive; frame name not stated in the label

registration.method: 5 m block mean of image vs DEM mean-low-Sun proxy, 25-px high-pass, integer NCC + parabola

display.processing: linear, 0.5-99.5 percentile of valid pixels -> 1..255; 0 = no data

limitations: Average of many NAC images under different Sun directions: not a real lighting state, and shading is baked in.
Never an input to horizons, rays, elevations or metrics.
Registration to the PGDA 78 5 m DEM is not guaranteed by either product; see the registration check in docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md.
Units of the averaged pixel value are not stated in the label read here; treated as relative brightness.
Covers only its bounds; outside them the renderer must show neutral shading, never invented imagery.
